name: A Donation of Wool
summary: The Windshapers are taking wool cloth donations, and sixty pieces will earn their full recognition.

sections.title: A Gift of Wool
sections.body: The Windshapers accept wool cloth from you. When you are ready to give, their representative can take sixty pieces.

faq.answer: The Windshapers are accepting wool cloth donations.

faq.q: How much wool cloth should I give?
faq.answer: Give the Windshapers sixty pieces of wool cloth for full recognition.

faq.q: What do I get for donating the wool?
faq.answer: Sixty pieces of wool cloth earn the Windshapers’ full recognition for your generosity.

faq.q: Can their representative take the wool now?
faq.answer: Their representative can take the sixty pieces when you have them with you and are ready to donate.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Donation of Wool
